summary: Tested RISEDUALAI auth system and AI hypothesis features. Backend APIs (14 tests) all pass. Frontend login flow blocked by CORS issue at infrastructure level.

integration_issues.issue: CORS conflict: Ingress/Cloudflare adds 'access-control-allow-origin: *' which is incompatible with 'credentials: include'. Browser blocks requests.
integration_issues.root_cause: Infrastructure CORS headers conflict with httpOnly cookie auth. The ingress returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' but backend sets 'access-control-allow-credentials: true'. Per CORS spec, wildcard origin cannot be used with credentials.
integration_issues.workaround: Either: (1) Configure ingress to not add CORS headers and let backend handle it, OR (2) Switch to localStorage-based JWT auth instead of httpOnly cookies

integration_issues.issue: Same CORS issue affects hypothesis fetch with credentials

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix CORS configuration at infrastructure level. The ingress/Cloudflare is adding 'access-control-allow-origin: *' which conflicts with 'credentials: include' in frontend fetch calls.
Option A: Configure ingress to pass through backend CORS headers without modification
Option B: Switch from httpOnly cookies to localStorage-based JWT auth (less secure but avoids CORS credential issues)
Option C: Use a proxy endpoint that doesn't require credentials for initial auth

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Frontend login and hypothesis requests hang indefinitely
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: CORS configuration conflict between ingress/Cloudflare and backend
rca_of_the_issue.details: The ingress/Cloudflare proxy adds 'access-control-allow-origin: *' to all responses. The backend sets 'access-control-allow-credentials: true' for httpOnly cookie auth. Per CORS spec, wildcard origin (*) cannot be used with credentials. Browser blocks the request.
rca_of_the_issue.evidence: curl -v shows response headers: 'access-control-allow-origin: *' AND 'access-control-allow-credentials: true' - this combination is invalid
reproduction_steps: 6. Check browser console - no error shown but request never completes
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Configure ingress to not add CORS headers, or switch to localStorage-based auth
